provenance.rule: Cells are copied from the reviewed workbook. Tags say whether a company number is a print, a floor, a target, or an estimate.

sites.name: Vineland NJ (DataOne)
sites.note: FY2025 20-F: first build-to-suit, Vineland, NJ, signed February 2025. Nebius is the tenant. DataOne owns the shell. Microsoft is the customer. Energized rows are IT MW, genset-capped.

sites.name: Independence MO (Eastgate)
sites.note: FY2025 20-F: Missouri and Finland are the greenfield sites. Newly owned land, February 2026. 1.2 GW in the Q1 2026 letter. No energized IT through Q2 2026.

sites.name: Butler Twp PA (Highridge)
sites.note: Owned site announced May 2026, after the 20-F. On the 12 Aug 2026 letter map as Pennsylvania. Up to 1.2 GW. Treated as greenfield because the company says it owns the land. Not in the 20-F site list.

sites.name: Birmingham AL (BHM01, Oxmoor)
sites.note: FY2025 20-F: newly owned Alabama site, and the filing groups Alabama with Missouri as a greenfield. The address is a former operations building, which also fits the company's brownfield definition. The filing's word is greenfield. No revenue IT in 1H 2026.

sites.name: Bethune FR (Azur Datacenter, ex-Bridgestone)
sites.note: Azur, former Bridgestone plant. Contracted in Q1 2026. Energized base still 0 at Q2 2026.

sites.name: Lappeenranta FI (Pajarila / Polarnode)
sites.note: Owned Finnish site, 310 MW, first customer capacity guided for 2027. Not named in the 20-F bullet list. The 12 Aug 2026 letter adds a Finland site. Classed greenfield because the company says it owns the land.

sites.name: Mantsala FI #1
sites.note: FY2025 20-F: Mäntsälä is a greenfield data center built to Nebius's design. Oct 2024 release said capacity would triple to 75 MW.

sites.name: Mantsala FI #2 (Kapuli)
sites.note: Kapuli, next to the Mäntsälä greenfield. The 20-F does not name this plot separately. Offset from site 1 so both pins are visible.

sites.name: Kansas City MO (Patmos)
sites.note: Patmos colo. 5 MW class from early 2025, expandable toward 40 MW.

sites.name: Paris (Equinix PA10)
sites.note: Equinix PA10. Megawatts are a small third-party figure, not a Nebius disclosure.

sites.name: Keflavik IS (Verne)
sites.note: Verne, private region, live from Q1 2025.

sites.name: London Longcross (Ark LP01)
sites.note: Ark LP01 at Longcross.

sites.name: Harlow UK (Kao Data KLON-02/03)
sites.note: Kao Data KLON. Ten-year colo.

sites.name: Newport UK (Vantage CWL1)
sites.note: Vantage CWL1, announced 13 Aug 2026. MW not disclosed on its own.

sites.name: UK 3rd new deployment (lead: Green Mountain LON-East, Romford)
sites.note: Lead only: Green Mountain LON-East, Romford. Not a confirmed Nebius campus.

sites.name: Modi'in IL (Mega Or)
sites.note: Mega Or. Energized rows are IT MW. Launched Oct 2025.

sites.name: Masmiyya IL (Mega DC)
sites.note: Mega DC. Pin is approximate.

sites.name: Beit Shemesh IL (Mega DC)
sites.note: Mega DC. Landlord completion slides point at 2027.

sites.name: Madrid-Getafe ES (Merlin Edged)
sites.note: Merlin Edged. Phase 1 went live in Sep 2026, after the history window.

sites.name: Tallinn EE (Greenergy Huuru)
sites.note: Greenergy Huuru. Contracted in Q2 2026.

sites.name: Minnesota colo (us-north1, Woodbury)
sites.note: FY2025 20-F: co-location in Minnesota, February 2026. The filing does not name the city. Woodbury is the docs region us-north1, not a campus disclosure.

sites.name: Oklahoma colo (unnamed)
sites.note: FY2025 20-F: co-location in Oklahoma, contracts secured February 2026. The town is not stated, so it is not pinned. The site itself is company-reported.

sites.name: France 2nd colo (unnamed; possibly eu-west2)
sites.note: FY2025 20-F: two new French co-location sites in February 2026, in addition to Paris. Towns are not named. Béthune is one landlord-identified town. This row is the other unnamed contract.

sites.name: AIB CLT1 (Moore, Spartanburg County SC; Lockhart Power)
sites.note: Not on the 12 Aug 2026 Nebius location map and not in the 20-F. AIB's own 8-K on 30 Sep 2026 says 50 MW IT at its South Carolina site. Co-location. Quarterly history stays empty through Q2 2026.
